The idea

Make the intermediate steps explicit

Tools
Everything in a single passpicks the tools · decides every argument · generates the dialogue
Dialogue
Nothing in between to check
Domain
name
1Tool graphtools and their links
2Samplera tool sequence and its goal
3Planevery step, every source
4Dialoguethe plan put into words

Each stage produces an intermediate result we can check.

Limitations

What ToolWeave does not do yet

Simulated toolsTool responses follow the schema, but the APIs are not executed.
More LLM calls30.2K LLM calls per 1,000 dialogues, versus 13.6K for ToolFlow.
Text-only toolsNo tools with GUIs or visual outputs yet.
No domain policiesPolicy rules and settings are not part of the synthesis yet.

Next: executable synthetic APIs, and dialogues that follow domain policies.

What the numbers compare

Base modelstays fixed
Fine-tuning setupstays fixed
Training dataToolDialToolFlowToolWeave
What we do not claim: leaderboard state of the art

Frontier proprietary systems score much higher on the BFCL-V3 leaderboard. They are not directly comparable: they use far costlier approaches, differ in model scale, training data and inference setup, and their rankings shift often.

We compare the training data with everything else fixed.

Appendix · results

Synthetic tools vs real APIs

Tools from RapidAPI or generated by ToolWeave
ToolWeave-R: RapidAPI schemasToolWeave: synthetic tools

RapidAPI schemas do not specify which output feeds which input, so links rely on parameter similarity and can be noisy.
